# Storage

Filesystem archive of source material and archive-path / download policy.

**Tier:** Core

## Modules

| Module | Size | Classes | Functions |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `influx.storage` | L | 2 | 5 |

## Public API

### `influx.storage`
- class `ArchivePathError` — Raised when archive path construction fails safety checks.
- def `build_archive_path` — Build an archive filesystem path and note-facing relative path.
- class `ArchiveResult` — Outcome of an archive download attempt.
- def `download_archive` — Download a file via the guarded HTTP client and archive it.
- def `archive_bytes` — Archive already-in-memory *body* (no network fetch).
- def `resolve_within_root` — Resolve *path* against *root* and confirm it lives under it; else raise.
- def `download_archive_autodetect` — Fetch a URL once and archive it, routing on the real Content-Type.
